title: fix(console): Home's Recently Accessed leaves out a row whose object is not registered, and never asks it by name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgPKDiLo5gfWzDLyAK6J6UjZ)_
Fixes #34692

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:首页「最近访问」里,对象所在的包已被停用的行(记录、对象、列表视图)不再显示,也不再为它按名请求 `/meta/object/NAME`(此前每次进首页一次 404);首页改为用一次 `?names=` 批量读确认这些对象是否还在。
- **为什么改**:与 #26988 在记录页相关列表、仪表盘 `requiresObject`、导航 `requiresObject` 上的规则一致:注册对象列表里没有的对象,不画、不问。
- **风险与回滚**:只改界面。首页有对象类最近行时多一次 `GET /meta/object?names=…` 批量读;批量读回来之前,这些行照常显示(记录标题、类型图标),只是暂不按名读对象。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` 的 `readRecentObjects`(谁算不在、何时不读);② 同文件 `recentApps` 一段(先剔除再取前六条);③ `describeRecent` / `labelRecent` 里 `unread` 分支(未答复时不发按名读)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.recentDisabledPackage-34692.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `HomePage.tsx` gains `readRecentObjects(metadata, names)`: what Home may do with the object a recent row names, `read` / `unread` / `absent`.
  - While nothing has loaded the whole object registry, the rows' object names are asked in ONE `GET /meta/object?names=` presence read through `readObjectPresence` (`console/appObjectScope.ts`, the helper the navigation, the `nav:menu` block and the record route share). A name the read answered served is `read`, a name it left out is `absent`, a name not answered yet (or whose read failed) is `unread`.
  - Once the whole registry is loaded or on its way, or on a context with no scope reads, `objectPresence` (`hooks/useObjectPresence.ts`) answers from that list; only a list that answered and holds other objects can say `absent`.
- `recentApps` drops `absent` rows BEFORE taking the six, so a dropped row holds no place.
- An `unread` row is drawn and nothing is asked by name for it: `describeRecent` returns the object's bundle label (else its name) as a record's context and no icon; `labelRecent` gives an object or list-view row its object's bundle plural label (else its name), a record row its stored title. This is the #26988 deferral (an entry its list has not answered is drawn) plus `servedByName`'s rule (a name joins the by-name scope once the presence read answered it served).
- Drop, not inert: the #26988 sites (`pruneUnregisteredRecordPageObjects`, `DashboardView`'s widget filter, the navigation gate) all remove the entry, so this follows them.

## Tests

- New pin `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.recentDisabledPackage-34692.test.tsx` (real `HomePage` + real `MetadataProvider` over a fake adapter that serves only the enabled packages' objects and answers 404 by name for a disabled one):
  1. a record visited while its package was enabled draws with its icon; after the package is disabled it is not drawn, and the only object reads are `object?names=crm_account,pm_project` and `object/crm_account` (CONTROL: the served object's row still draws with its icon);
  2. object and list-view rows of the disabled package are left out too, with no by-name read for it;
  3. a left-out row holds no place among the six;
  4. while the presence read is held unanswered, the row is drawn with the kind's icon and nothing is asked by name; once it answers, the row goes and still nothing is asked by name.
- Ablation (committed fix first; mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `3e5623c964c7` to `21043f3e6b70`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty): `readRecentObjects`'s presence branch replaced by an always-`read` answer turns all 4 cases red.

## Acceptance notes

- **The 29121 pin, fixed on this branch:** `HomePage.recentObjectReads-29121.test.tsx`'s fake adapter recorded the new `?names=` presence read under the bare `object` spelling (the whole-list read). Its area widened this card's file surface to that file, fixture only: the fake now records a `names` read with its query and filters by `names`, and the two exact read sets each gain the one presence read (`object?names=crm_account,crm_contact` / `object?names=crm_account,crm_lead`); no assertion was removed or weakened (`baa81840`, plus the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test, `bf43e6ed`). It passes.
- `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` pins `HomePage.tsx`'s literal `useObjectTranslation` import line; `useObjectLabel` is imported on its own line so that line stays as pinned (`e847ae4c`).
- Merged `origin/main` at `be42dd0e`; at that head the two Home pins plus `perm-home-namespace-3546` pass (Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 43 passed (43)).
- One extra request on Home when recent rows name objects: the batched presence read. Served objects are still read by name afterwards for their icon and label, as before.
